Learning to learn; the learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they practise reading sentences containing decodable and non- decodable

words for fluency.

Values:
Unity; cooperation is developed as the learner works collaboratively with others in reciting a choral verse.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill (self-esteem); the learner’s self-esteem is enhanced when they acquire reading fluency skills.

Reading fluency is also emphasised in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.
